title: The Little Boy with five loaves and two fish
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells the five loaves and two fish (John 6:1-14) and states lessons: share, God provides, give thanks, do not waste.

floor.question: What did God provide for the widow?
floor.answer: Flour and oil that did not run out

representations: five paper loaves and two paper fish
steps: Count the loaves, fish and baskets.

board.do: Wait for the child to say the leftovers.

misconceptions.repair: Hold up five fingers for loaves and two for fish while saying it.

misconceptions.ask: Who gave the loaves and fish?
misconceptions.repair: Read John 6:9. Andrew found the boy.

misconceptions.ask: How much food was left over?
misconceptions.repair: Read John 6:13 and count twelve baskets.

misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus do before sharing the food?
misconceptions.repair: Read John 6:11. Practise saying grace before snack.

checks.question: How many loaves did the boy have?
Name a lesson from the miracle.
